description: This is a PHP class source file defining the 'Information' model in the OpenCart catalog module. The class provides methods to retrieve information entities and their details, including layout IDs, from the database.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Model class responsible for fetching information data related to the catalog from the database.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information data for a specific information ID.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all information entries available.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific information entry.
